notes.title: Floorball Practice – Release Month, Pre-Alpha, Discord & More!
notes.notes:
This is a re-upload from April 2, 2025


Discord Community
We're thrilled to announce that we've launched our very own Discord channel, and we'd love for you to join our growing community! Here, you can discuss the game, share suggestions, and talk about all things floorball, including the WFCs. Join us now and be part of the conversation!


 👉 Join our Discord here!



Early Access & Pre-Alpha Details
Floorball Practice is set to launch in Early Access on Steam in December 2025 for approximately $19.99 USD. But if you want to support us early and gain exclusive access, you can pre-order and play the Pre-Alpha build as early as September 2025! Visit our Discord for more details on how to get in.


More Exciting News Coming Soon!
This summer, we’ll start revealing and showcasing some of the floorball brands that will be featured in Floorball Practice—stay tuned for updates!


New Official Domains!
We’ve also secured these new domains for our game:


 🌐 www.floorballgame.com


 🌐 www.floorballgames.com


 🌐 www.floorball-practice.com



Help Us Grow!
You can support us by sharing Floorball Practice with friends, on social media, or even in real life! Tell everyone to wishlist the game and join our Discord—2025 is going to be an exciting year as we shape the future of floorball gaming!
